title: Generic restriction of continuous coefficient sections on a normal scheme
statement:
Let $X$ be a nonempty normal integral locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], where normal means that every local ring is a domain integrally closed in its fraction field [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Write $k=\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$ for its function field at the generic point $\eta$, and $j:\operatorname{Spec}k\to X$ for the generic inclusion. Let $A$ be a nonarchimedean normed field, meaning a field with an absolute value satisfying $|a+b|\leq\max(|a|,|b|)$, and its metric topology. Put $R_{A,T}=p_T^*\underline A$ for every scheme $T$, where $\underline A(S)=C(S,A)$ for profinite $S$ [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the canonical continuous-function realization [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-field-continuous-realization]. For every affine object $U\to X$ of the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $U_\eta=U\times_X\operatorname{Spec}k$. Restriction gives a bijection of rings
$$C(|U|,A)\xrightarrow{\sim}C(|U_\eta|,A).$$
These bijections commute with every $X$-morphism between affine pro-etale objects, and with postcomposition by continuous field homomorphisms $A\to A'$. The empty object is included. No completeness or local compactness of $A$ is assumed.

source.place: Agent extension of the normal generic-point argument: Lemma 7.4.10, p. 71, and Theorem 2.3.4 (ind-etale refinement). Coefficient realization: Hemo–Richarz–Scholbach, Example 3.1, p. 6. Discrete analogue: literature/stacks-project/etale-cohomology.tex, Tag 09Z5, lemma-push-constant-sheaf-from-open (1). This norm-topology statement is not quoted as Tag 09Z5 itself.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-normal-generic-chart-clopens] to $U\to X$. Its basis consists of affine opens $W$ over nonempty affine opens of $X$, and it supplies the bijections $\operatorname{Clop}(W)\to\operatorname{Clop}(W_\eta)$, including the zero-ring charts. The normal, integral and locally Noetherian hypotheses are precisely those of $X$.

source.place: Tag 092W, lemma-normality-goes-up; agent chart and idempotent deduction from the returned parent proof steps 1-2. Clopen correspondence: literature/stacks-project/algebra.tex, Tag 00EE, lemma-disjoint-decomposition.

proof.text: Use that basis in [lem-sfb-normal-generic-component-comparison]. Since $U$ is affine, it yields an affine generic fibre and the homeomorphism $h:\pi_0(U_\eta)\to\pi_0(U)$ normalized by $h q_{U_\eta}=q_Ui$, where $i:U_\eta\to U$ is the actual projection. No affine-intersection assumption on $X$ is needed.

source.place: Tag 0906, lemma-spectral-pi0; agent local-to-global clopen gluing and affine generic-fibre argument in returned parent proof steps 3-4; the final clopen criterion is lem-sfb-spectral-clopen-component-homeomorphism, not Tag 0906 alone.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-ultrametric-component-map-extension] to this $i,h$ and the stated $A$. It gives a ring isomorphism for actual restriction, with inverse $E_U(f)=\bar f h^{-1}q_U$, and establishes that $A$ is totally disconnected. The empty-object case and arbitrary, possibly incomplete, nonarchimedean absolute values are included in that statement.

source.place: Lemma 4.2.12, last paragraph (factorization through components); agent ultrametric separation and inverse-composition argument of returned parent proof steps 5-6, generalized to topological spaces.

proof.text: For an $X$-morphism $v:V\to U$, its generic base change satisfies $i_Uv_\eta=vi_V$. Thus $(g\circ v)\circ i_V=(g\circ i_U)\circ v_\eta$, proving object naturality. The generic restrictions of $E_U(f)\circ v$ and $E_V(f\circ v_\eta)$ are equal, so injectivity for $V$ identifies them. For a continuous field homomorphism $a:A\to A\prime$, composition is continuous and $a\circ(g\circ i_U)=(a\circ g)\circ i_U$. This proves coefficient naturality; uniqueness of extension for $A\prime$ likewise gives $a\circ E_U^A(f)=E_U^{A\prime}(a\circ f)$.

source.place: Fibre-product projection equations; elementary composition and uniqueness using the injectivity of step 3 for $V$ and for $A\prime$

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-field-continuous-realization] to the totally disconnected normed field $A$ from step 3. With [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring] and [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], this identifies $R_{A,T}=p_T^*\underline A$, $\underline A(S)=C(S,A)$, with the continuous-function ring sheaf. Hence the computed maps are the required continuous coefficient restriction maps. No completeness or local compactness entered.

lean.statement: theorem normal_generic_continuous_sections (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hnormal : ∀ x : X, IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (A : Type v) [NormedField A] [IsUltrametricDist A] : (∀ (U : X.ProEt), IsAffine U.left → Function.Bijective (ContinuousMap.compRightAlgHom ℤ A (pullback.fst U.hom (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))).base.hom).toRingHom) ∧ (∀ (U V : X.ProEt), IsAffine U.left → IsAffine V.left → ∀ (f : V ⟶ U) (g : C(U.left, A)), (g.comp f.left.base.hom).comp (pullback.fst V.hom (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))).base.hom = (g.comp (pullback.fst U.hom (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))).base.hom).comp (((Over.pullback (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))).map ((Scheme.ProEt.forget X).map f)).left.base.hom)) ∧ (∀ (A' : Type w) [NormedField A'] [IsUltrametricDist A'] (a : A →+* A') (ha : Continuous a) (U : X.ProEt), IsAffine U.left → ∀ g : C(U.left, A), (a.compLeftContinuous U.left ha g).comp (pullback.fst U.hom (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))).base.hom = a.compLeftContinuous ↥(pullback (C := Scheme.{u}) U.hom (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))) ha (g.comp (pullback.fst U.hom (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))).base.hom))
